function.name: run_oracle_script
function.description: Run one predefined Oracle DBA script on one or more database hosts through the jump server, as the oracle user. Only these scripts exist: showsid (/dba/bin/showsid: list SIDs and status), showusers (/dba/bin/showusers: users and sessions), dba_checkout (/dba/bin/dba_checkout: health checkout), start_oracle (/dba/bin/start_oracle: STARTS Oracle; confirm with the user first), maint_mode (/dba/bin/maint_mode.sh -s: maintenance-mode status). Returns stdout, stderr, exit_code, status and duration per host. If the error is not_logged_in, ask the user to log in to the tool; never ask for their password.

hosts.description: Database server hostnames or IPs, e.g. ["proddb01.example.com"].

function.name: list_oracle_scripts
function.description: List the allowlisted scripts the Oracle jump-server tool can run.

function.name: get_jump_session_status
function.description: Check whether the user is logged in to the jump server through the tool, and when the session expires.
